title: 第22章危机
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
两人走出总堂，阿三忍不住低声抱怨：“他娘的，白跑一趟，还惹了一身骚。那对父子，真他妈晦气！”

    “行了，”阿四不屑地啐了一口，“一个废物，一个老不死，还能翻了天不成？赶紧回去睡觉，明天还得去码头那边转转。”

    在他们看来，这件事，已经彻底翻篇。

    两人骂骂咧咧地穿过几条街巷，拐进了一条平日里就人迹罕至的回家必经之路。

    巷子狭窄而幽深，两侧高墙挡住了月光，空气中弥漫着一股挥之不去的恶臭。

    就在两人走到巷子中段时，脚步同时一顿。

    前方，一道佝偻的身影，如同一截枯木，悄无声息地挡住了他们的去路。

    正是伪装后的陈安。

    “嗯？”

    阿三和阿四皆是货真价实的气血狼烟境武者，瞬间便察觉到眼前这人身上有微弱的气血波动。

    但那气息，虚浮不定，仿佛风中残烛，随时都会熄灭。

    两人对视一眼，脸上不约而同地露出了狞笑。

    “嘿，哪来的老不死的，大半夜不睡觉，跑这儿来等死？”

    阿三晃了晃脖子，发出咔咔的脆响。

    “看这身板，怕不是活腻了，想不开寻短见？正好，爷们送你一程！”

    阿四怪笑着，从腰间抽出了那柄沾过陈龙鲜血的短刀。

    在他们眼中，眼前这个老家伙，不过是哪个想不开的蟊贼，或者是走错了路的流浪汉。

    然而，陈安没有一句废话。

    就在阿四开口嘲讽的瞬间，他那佝偻的身躯，如一张被瞬间拉满的霸王弓，骤然绷直！

    静若处子，动如雷霆！

    圆满境界的《鲸吞功》在体内轰然爆发！

    丹田内那团白色的气雾瞬间沸腾，化作一股恐怖力量，尽数灌注于右拳之上！

    六百公斤的纯粹力量，没有丝毫花哨，目标直指离他最近的阿三！

    “找死！”

    阿三瞳孔一缩，虽然惊诧于对方速度的变化，但身为气血狼烟境武者的本能，还是让他下意识地催动全身气血，双臂交叉，悍然格挡！

    然而，在陈安那超越了常理、凝练到极致的纯粹力量面前，他引以为傲的气血防御，脆弱得如同纸糊！

    “咔嚓！”

    双臂骨骼应声粉碎！
content_en:
The two of them walked out of the main hall, and Ah San couldn't help but complain in a low voice: "Damn, it was a waste of time, and it made me a mess. That father and son are so damn unlucky!"

    "Okay," Ah Si spat disdainfully, "How can a waste and an old man turn the world upside down? Go back to bed quickly. We have to go to the dock tomorrow."

    In their view, this matter has completely changed.

    The two of them walked through several streets and alleys, cursing, and turned into a usually infrequent road home.

    The alley was narrow and deep, with high walls on both sides blocking the moonlight, and a lingering stench filled the air.

    Just when the two of them reached the middle of the alley, their footsteps stopped at the same time.

    Ahead, a rickety figure, like a dead tree, silently blocked their way.

    It is Chen An in disguise.

    "Huh?"

    Ah San and Ah Si were both genuine Qi and Blood Wolf Smoke Realm warriors, and they instantly noticed the weak Qi and Blood fluctuations in the man in front of them.

    But that aura was floating and uncertain, like a candle in the wind that could be extinguished at any time.

    The two of them looked at each other, with a ferocious smile on their faces.

    "Hey, how can this old man stay up all night and come here to wait for death?"

    Ah San shook his neck and made a snapping sound.

    "Looking at your body, I'm afraid you're tired of life and can't think of committing suicide? Just in time, I'll give you a ride!"

    The fourth monster smiled and took out the short knife stained with Chen Long's blood from his waist.

    In their eyes, the old guy in front of them is just a thief who can't get over his head, or a homeless man who has gone astray.

    However, Chen An didn't say any nonsense.

    The moment Ah Si opened his mouth to taunt, his rickety body suddenly straightened like an overlord's bow that had been fully drawn in an instant!

    Silent as a virgin, moving as thunder!

    The perfect state of "Whale Swallowing Skill" exploded in the body!

    The white mist in the dantian boiled instantly and turned into a terrifying force, pouring all of it into the right fist!

    Six hundred kilograms of pure power, without any bells and whistles, aimed directly at Ah San who was closest to him!

    "Seeking death!"

    Ah San's pupils shrank. Although he was surprised by the change in the opponent's speed, his instinct as a Qi and Blood Wolf Smoke Realm warrior still made him subconsciously activate his Qi and blood, cross his arms, and block boldly!

    However, in front of Chen An's pure power that transcended common sense and was condensed to the extreme, his proud blood defense was as fragile as paper!

    "Crack!"

    The bones of both arms shattered!
